answer: The ledger counts names, not wishes, and every name on it has paid its own way. The defence is the price itself, and the price does not negotiate. A name without Tidebound island fisherman net-loft seal is turned away at the counter, and a seal fishermen renew after quay reviews is the reason the counter can tell. Each name is charged a deposit of 7 credits, frozen until 21 days after the grading closes, and the charges stack up faster than the rewards do. The forge is checked, not assumed. pigment stays on the record. The clerk notes velvet.
